title: Remove Nth Node From End
statement:
Given the head of a linked list, remove the n-th node from the end of the list and return its head (as an array of values).

Solve this in one pass by using two pointers separated by a gap of `n`.
inputFormat:
Line 1: two integers `sz` and `n`.
Line 2: `sz` space-separated integers for the list values.
outputFormat: Space-separated integers: the list with the n-th node from the end removed.

starterCode.python:
sz, n = map(int, input().split())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
